kinds.d: Blown or emptied eggshell, or a dried nest, kept as a specimen. An egg for hatching is not sold here. Wild-bird egg collecting is illegal in many places.

x.d: Largest living bird egg, about 15 cm long and 1.4 kg; decorated and silver-mounted for centuries.
Subfossil egg of Aepyornis, the largest known amniote egg at 26–40 cm.
Historic wild-bird egg collections; UK possession lawful only if taken before 1954 or under permit.
